description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring a Cinder volume source in Kubernetes, including methods for building configuration objects with chaining.

classes.name: CinderVolumeSourceApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration for a Cinder volume source in Kubernetes, supporting setting volume ID, filesystem type, read-only flag, and secret reference.

methods.name: CinderVolumeSource
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new CinderVolumeSourceApplyConfiguration object.

methods.name: WithVolumeID
methods.description: Sets the volume ID in the configuration.

methods.name: WithFSType
methods.description: Sets the filesystem type for the volume.

methods.name: WithReadOnly
methods.description: Sets the read-only flag for the volume.

methods.name: WithSecretRef
methods.description: Sets the secret reference for connecting to OpenStack.
